method: Owned headless Chromium and fresh disposable browser context. Browser View extension is used only to locate Playwright; no shared CDP connection, profile or learner state is accessed.
sandboxException: Existing explicit browser-view allowNoSandbox configuration honoured for this isolated root-host test.

checks.label: New A2 session displays the chapter bank and pins it on visible card practice
A started version-one session without bankId keeps its old bank, recalled cards and pinned bank after update/reload
Optional gist supports a wrong attempt, correction and persisted drafts over reload without credit
Optional retell draft and criteria persist, edit resets both criteria, and no XP or minutes are added
Chapter vocabulary deep link selects and focuses its bank, then returns to the same session
Three A2 turns plus visible mistake repair complete the chapter extra; wrong-first/hint evidence survives reload without repeated XP
Opening a chapter conversation intent preserves an unrelated active round, first answer, index and draft
All seven budgets match planned/session duration via Today and direct entry, reload as valid backups, and preserve an older 15-minute session
EN/IT input, retelling, chapter vocabulary and A2 conversation fit 320, 390 and 1440 pixel viewports
Disposable contexts produced no runtime errors, external requests or network mutations

limits: Synthetic programme positions isolate chapter flows; this is not a human completion of all eighty days.
Responsive layouts were tested at desktop-emulated viewport widths, not physical phones.
Device speech audio quality and pronunciation were not assessed; public authored scenes and optional tasks were exercised without publisher audio.
Core persistence flows use chapter 1; responsive checks additionally sample chapters 9 and 10 rather than every chapter.
No production site, shared reader session, real learner progress, local database or backup was accessed.
